Hey there! I am a two thirds data science, one third psychology researcher. My
[research](https://c-monaghan.github.io/research/) is particularly focused on
studying the reasons behind why older adults may procrastinate and the
consequences of such procrastination.

At the moment I am a postdoctoral researcher at the
[School of Allied Health](https://www.ul.ie/ehs/school-allied-health) in the
[University of Limerick](https://www.ul.ie/) working with the
[ISCycle](https://www.iscycle.ie/) team to investigate the impact of electric
bikes on transport behavior, physical activity, and the environment (slightly
different from procrastination I know!).

In addition, I am a part time lecturer at the [Department of Mathematics and Statistics](https://www.maynoothuniversity.ie/mathematics-and-statistics)
in [Maynooth University](https://www.maynoothuniversity.ie/).
